description: Cursor Agent detection rules. It has no approval hook, so its key-bound menu is read from the screen.

rules.why: The run-this-command menu is the only sign Cursor is waiting; it is bounded to the last 8 lines because an answered menu stays in scrollback, and its choices must end in a key hint (and the last line too) because narration can repeat the wording.

all.regex: (?:run \(once\)|to allowlist\?|run everything|skip & tell the agent)[^\n]*\((?:shift\+tab|ctrl\+[a-z]|esc(?: or [a-z])?|tab|enter|return|space|[a-z]|[↵⇧↹⎋⏎]{1,3})\)[ \t]*\n[\s\S]*\((?:shift\+tab|ctrl\+[a-z]|esc(?: or [a-z])?|tab|enter|return|space|[a-z]|[↵⇧↹⎋⏎]{1,3})\)[ \t]*(?![\s\S])

rules.why: Under the Cursor Agent banner the persistent `→` prompt with a braille spinner frame means a turn is running; a closed-form version of Orca's last-banner anchor.
The same `→` prompt with no spinner frame is the rest screen, but the prompt stays painted between spinner frames, so the screen must be quiet.
